summary_md: **atomic.chat ([@atomic_chat_hq](https://x.com/atomic_chat_hq/status/2115716612758417666))** releases a GGUF quant ladder of NVIDIA's 30B **Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe** speech model for NeMo-Speech.cpp, from 35GB down to 13.6GB, reporting that quants from 15.5GB up match BF16 on a 2,200-clip test, so it fits a 24GB GPU ([AtomicChat GGUF on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/AtomicChat/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-GGUF)).
relevance: Local 30B speech recognition that fits easily on a DGX Spark.
